title: Tomato Caesar Salad with Ciabatta Croutons
changes_from_base: Ripe tomatoes take the place of the romaine, and the egg-free dressing is a sharp anchovy vinaigrette rather than a mayonnaise base.
summary: Summer tomatoes take the starring role in this Caesar: chunky wedges and cherry tomatoes tossed in a punchy anchovy-Parmesan vinaigrette with crisp cheesy ciabatta croutons.

ingredients.item: anchovy fillets in oil, finely chopped, plus extra to serve (optional)
large ripe tomatoes, cut into chunky wedges

steps.title: Bake the croutons
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan). Toss the bread with the oil, Parmesan and garlic, spread on the tray and bake 15-18 min, stirring once, until golden. Cool.

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.text: In the large bowl, mash the anchovies and garlic together, then whisk in the lemon juice, mustard, tamarind, Parmesan, oil and pepper.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add all the tomatoes and the cooled croutons, sprinkle with the flaky salt and toss gently.

steps.title: Rest and serve
steps.text: Leave 10-15 min so the croutons soak up some juice at the edges, then pile onto a platter and top with extra anchovies if you like.

tips: Use the ripest tomatoes you can find and keep them out of the fridge.
Let the salad sit for 10-15 min so the croutons soften slightly at the edges.
Leave out the extra anchovies on top if serving cautious eaters.
storage: Best eaten on the day. Keep any leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
